title: UBL Kernel v1.0 — Native Execution and Practical State-Routing Validation
description:
Supplemental research update for the frozen Universal Binary Language (UBL) Kernel v1.0.0. Includes the existing independent public Python contract reference and temperature example, an additional editable two-state lifecycle illustration, public tests and a bounded native instruction-count research summary. Run python -m conformance.lifecycle and python -m unittest discover -s conformance -p 'test_*.py' -v with Python 3.11+ and no extra packages.

The report separates author-reported private native measurements from publicly runnable examples. It includes equal-contract original/optional/packed8 instruction counts, fixed inventory and code-size tradeoffs, and the dominant SHA-256 work. It does not establish architectural superiority, physical timing or energy, complete conformance, power-loss durability or novelty. The private implementation and raw profiles are withheld; the public illustration does not reproduce those measurements.

CC BY 4.0 applies only to this public archive. The previous November 14 runnable archive DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24209493 and original October archive DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23845298 remain distinct version records. No new kernel version.
